package.description: Zero-config, zero-token P2P E2EE file transfer, chat, and MCP server for AI agents

en-US.description: Zero-config, zero-token P2P E2EE file transfer, chat, and MCP server for AI agents
en-US.longDescription: SRIFT is a zero-config, zero-token peer-to-peer secure file transfer tool, encrypted chat, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI coding agents (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, Continue, Zed) and developers. Sessions and --encrypt links are end-to-end AES-256-GCM encrypted with keys made on the devices (ECDH P-256 + HKDF-SHA256); nothing is retained centrally.
en-US.name: SRIFT
